camel_example: aliyun iot QueryDevice --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --PageSize 10 --NextToken TGlzdFJlc291cm000 --CurrentPage 1 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
description_en: Queries the list of all devices under a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定产品下的所有设备列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 10 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --current-page 1 --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cm000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If the ID value is available, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page in the response. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是50。默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices belong
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的设备所属产品的**ProductKey**
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页的内容。默认值是 1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the **NextToken** value returned from the previous query.



When the product of **PageSize** and **CurrentPage** is greater than 10,000, you must specify **NextToken**. Otherwise, no data is returned.


><notice>
If you specify **NextToken**, the product of **PageSize** and **CurrentPage** must be less than 1,000,000. Otherwise, no data is returned.

></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识，首次查询无需传入。后续查询需使用的**NextToken**，要从上一次查询的返回结果中获取。



当**PageSize**×**CurrentPage**值大于10,000时，必须传入**NextToken**。否则，无法返回数据。


><notice>
如果传入**NextToken**值，则**PageSize**×**CurrentPage**值必须小于1,000,000。否则，无法返回数据。

></notice>
parameters.name: next_token
